title: [Vornavian Coast, The Hills]
description: The path is passable to the southwest, but is blocked to the northeast by a jumble of boulders and shattered stone.  The stone has fallen from the high walls on either side of the path, broken loose by years of erosion.

The path is passable to the southwest, but is blocked to the northeast by a jumble of boulders and shattered stone.  The stone has fallen from the high walls on either side of the path, broken loose by years of erosion.  Lizards climb amongst the fallen rocks, making their way to the top to sun themselves.
